## Summary

`infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:4-5` states the stack "Runs the two containers on the
AL2023 arm64 box: Gerrit (the code-review server) and the rebar review-bot (the FastAPI
webhook receiver)."

The same file defines **four** services: `gerrit` (line 27), `review-bot` (line 76),
`opcert` (line 346) and `mcp` (line 418). The header undercounts its own file by two.

## Root cause

The comment was written for epic `d251` / story S2, when the stack genuinely had two
containers. The `opcert` signer and `mcp` server were added later without updating the
file's own header, so the drift is additive and silent — nothing parses the comment, so
nothing failed when it went stale.

## Why this is separate from `edible-insane-mongrel`

That ticket corrects the same stale count in `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md:211-215`, and its
certified plan pins `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md` as its only file impact. This is a different
artifact with a different audience — an operator reading the compose file directly, who
never opens the setup guide — so it is corrected on its own rather than by widening a
certified plan after the fact.

## Approach

Rewrite the header's service inventory to name all four services and what each does, and
keep the existing nginx-is-not-in-this-stack note, which is still accurate.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml` lines 3-5 name `gerrit`, `review-bot`, `opcert`
      and `mcp`, verified by `grep -n "opcert\|mcp" infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`
      matching within the first 10 lines.
- [x] The header no longer contains the string `two containers`, verified by
      `grep -c "two containers" infra/compose/docker-compose.yml` printing `0`.
- [x] The nginx-runs-as-a-host-package statement is retained verbatim.
- [x] [non-codebase] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` exits 0, with the exit
      code recorded on this ticket.
      provenance: environment=GitHub Actions hosted runner, gating `ubuntu-latest, py3.13` matrix cell; principal=GitHub Actions CI on Gerrit change 2996 patch set; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the gating cell selects `not integration and not external`, the same set `make test` selects, and it voted `Verified +1` on the revision submitted as `bd8c1c4ced7`.

## Testing

`grep -n "two containers\|opcert\|mcp" infra/compose/docker-compose.yml` confirms the
inventory and the absence of the stale count. `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify`
is the pre-push gate and must exit 0; it covers the compose-file parity tests that read
this file.

## Verification evidence

Fix landed as Gerrit change 2996, merged to `main` as `bd8c1c4ced7`, which is the tip of
`origin/main` at close time. Every criterion below was checked against that committed tree
(`git show bd8c1c4ced7:infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`), not against a working copy.

- The header now reads "Runs four containers on the AL2023 arm64 box" and names all four
  services with their roles. The AC's cited `grep -n "opcert\|mcp"` matches at lines 5 and
  6, inside the required first 10.
- `grep -c "two containers"` prints `0`.
- The nginx statement is retained verbatim: the `git diff bd8c1c4ced7~1 bd8c1c4ced7` hunk
  shows the "nginx is NOT in this stack — it runs as a HOST package (dnf nginx + host
  certbot)..." lines as untouched context, so retention is proven by the diff rather than
  asserted.

The AC's line citation of 3-5 is one line low against the landed file: the inventory
occupies lines 4-6, because naming four services with their roles takes one line more than
naming two. The substance — the header naming all four — is met.
